C2_difference_from_C1: always 3 + 4 = 7 views (m = 4); secondary, never a gate
anchor_control: anchor RGB + anchor depth, the same full-role bounds as the variant's A/B state; a single view never reaches the >=2-view lifting support, so an anchor state carries the single-view depth bypass and learned priors only

depth_bypass.inputs: context RGB, measured context depth, context cameras; no query
depth_bypass.placement: after the >=2-view support gate: one measured view suffices
depth_bypass.sampling: nearest pixel of the full-resolution measured ray-distance map

only_difference_C0_C1: C1 differs from C0 only by the number of views in each training context: the role's 3 frozen context frames plus the first m of the scene's 4 evenly spaced free frames, m ~ U{0..4} drawn once per step from a separate generator (seed + 7919), in arrival order; the model, the 5150 shared parameters and their per-seed draw, the loss, TRAIN72, 6000 steps, the 32^3 grid and the bounds rule (CONTEXT_DEPTH: hull of the measured depth and cameras of the role's 3 context frames, anchor frame, frozen x1.1 padding, >=1 m) are identical. The scene order, query slots and ray indices are identical for every variant. DEV evaluation and checkpoint selection use the standard 3-view contexts.
state: query-independent; all DEV states sealed before query load; >=2 queries/state
